note: 数值为各模型最近一次公开读数（民主党赢得该院的胜率 %），每个模型自带 as_of，请以字段为准。市场数值为 11/02 选前终值（Polymarket / Kalshi 跨平台共识）。选举日 2026-11-03；每日自动同步已于 11/01 停用，本版为人工刷新的静态终版。

markets.name: 预测市场（Kalshi / Polymarket）
markets.note: 11/02 选前终值（Polymarket/Kalshi 共识）：民主党夺回众院 94~94.5%（Polymarket『R 不控制众院』94.5%、Balance of Power 拆分推算 94%）、夺回参院 71~72.5%、两院全胜 69.5~70.5%（Polymarket 11/2 03:00 UTC 快照 70.5%、Kalshi 69.5%）。数值为交易价格隐含概率，非民调。
markets.note_en: Pre-election final (11/2, Polymarket/Kalshi consensus): Democrats 94-94.5% for the House (Poly 'no GOP House control' 94.5%; Balance-of-Power split implies 94%), 71-72.5% for the Senate, 69.5-70.5% for a sweep (Polymarket 11/2 03:00 UTC snapshot 70.5%, Kalshi 69.5%). Prices imply probabilities; not polls.

expert_ratings.source: 终版汇总：Cook Political Report 10/30（众院净增上调至 +12~+25、参院 D 'slight favorites'、7 个参院 Tossup 中 6 个 R 持有）、Inside Elections 10/29–31（10/29 一次移 9 场参院评级向 D；终版众院 D 净增 20–30）、Sabato's Crystal Ball 10/30（MN→Likely D、LA 移向 D；当前 49D-46R-5 Tossup，终版 11/2 发布）、DDHQ 10/30（众院 82%/239 席、参院 62%/52 席）、Fox Power Rankings（众院 D 下限 223 席、参院 Tossup）、Karl Rove（众院 D +20~25、参院 50-50 偏 R 守）

raters.name: Cook Political Report
raters.senate: D 微弱占优（'slight favorites'）；7 个 Tossup（AK/IA/KS/ME/MI/OH/TX，6 个 R 持有）
raters.note: 10/23 民主党已在过半所需 218 席中整体占优；10/30 再将 12 场众院评级移向 D、净增上调至 +12~+25（18 个 Tossup，上限 240 席）；参院终版 D 'slight favorites'，NE/FL 调向更具竞争性，7 场关键战两党均有机会
raters.stance_en: Structurally shifting blue (final: slight D edge in Senate)
raters.note_en: Democrats favored outright in the 218 seats needed from 10/23; 10/30 moved 12 more House ratings toward D and raised the gain band to +12~+25 (18 Tossups, up to 240 seats); final Senate read: D 'slight favorites', NE/FL made more competitive, 7 key races still live for both parties

raters.name: Sabato's Crystal Ball
raters.note: 10/30 将 MN→Likely D、LA 移向民主党；当前预测 49D-46R-5 Tossup，终版预测 11/2 发布
raters.note_en: 10/30: MN→Likely D, LA moved toward D; currently projects 49D-46R-5 Tossups; final forecast due Nov 2

raters.name: Inside Elections
raters.note: 10/29 一次将 9 场参院评级移向 D（TX/OH→Tilt D、GA→Likely D、IA/KS→Tossup、SC/NE→Tilt R、LA/MS→Likely R）；终版众院 D 净增 20–30 席，为评级机构中最乐观
raters.note_en: 10/29 moved nine Senate ratings toward D in one pass (TX/OH→Tilt D, GA→Likely D, IA/KS→Tossup, SC/NE→Tilt R, LA/MS→Likely R); final House projection +20-30 D, the most bullish of the three raters

expert_ratings.note: 模型把全国普选领先（D+8~9pt）映射为众院 82–95% 胜率、参院 55–79%；三大评级机构 10/30 终版全线移向民主党但幅度更保守（Cook 众院 +12~25、Inside Elections +20~30）。提前投票已超 4300 万（AP 10/30，较 2022 同期多近 1000 万）。分歧核心仍是参议院：2026 年民调误差究竟走中期模式（D 跑赢）还是大选年模式（R 被低估），将直接决定归属。
expert_ratings.source_en: Final compilation: Cook 10/30 (House +12~+25, Senate D 'slight favorites', 7 Tossups with 6 R-held), Inside Elections 10/29-31 (nine Senate races moved toward D on 10/29; final House gain +20-30), Sabato's Crystal Ball 10/30 (MN→Likely D, LA moved toward D; currently 49D-46R-5 Tossups, final due 11/2), DDHQ 10/30 (House 82%/239, Senate 62%/52), Fox Power Rankings (House D floor 223, Senate Tossup), Karl Rove (House D +20-25, Senate 50-50 R hold)
expert_ratings.note_en: Models map the D+8~9pt national lead into House odds of 82-95% and Senate 55-79%; the three rating agencies' 10/30 finals all moved toward Democrats but stay more conservative (Cook House +12~25, Inside Elections +20~30). Early voting topped 43 million (AP 10/30, ~10M ahead of 2022). The core divergence remains the Senate: whether 2026's polling error follows the midterm pattern (D outperform) or the presidential-year pattern (R undercounted) will decide the chamber.

party_dynamics.source: 综合 POLITICO、AP/凤凰网、新华社环球、Al Jazeera、USA Today、WaPo/参考消息、Pew 10/8、Reuters/Ipsos、Silver Bulletin 10/13、Fox News 10/11-13、RCP 10/13 等 2026 年公开报道与初选结果整理；终版补充：NYT 均值 10/30（特朗普 37%）、AP 10/30（提前投票 4300 万+）、Politico 10/30–31（共和党备战'残酷之夜'）、CNN 10/27（generic ballot 52–43）

dem.theme: 路线之争：进步派 vs 建制派
dem.detail: “Mamdani 效应”与 DSA 崛起，纽约、科罗拉多等多名资深议员在初选被进步派击败；温和派(34%)与民主社会主义者(34%)势均力敌、互相警惕，分裂恰逢中期选举关键期。
dem.detail_en: The 'Mamdani effect' and DSA rise — multiple senior incumbent lawmakers lost primaries to progressives in NY, CO, etc.; moderates (34%) and democratic socialists (34%) are evenly matched and mutually wary, exactly during the critical midterm window.

dem.detail: 舒默(Schumer)的夺回战略遭本党进步派参议员公开“打脸”——在缅因/密歇根/明尼苏达背书反建制候选人；其领袖地位与 2026 命运直接挂钩。
dem.detail_en: Schumer's takeover strategy was publicly 'humiliated' by his own progressive senators — who endorsed anti-establishment candidates in ME/MI/MN; his leadership and 2026 fate are directly tied.

dem.detail: DNC 现金仅约 $16.5M、负债 $18.3M；全党战备金约 $400M，远低于共和党 ~$1B；众院选战金 R $89M vs D $76M（Federal filings 10月）；大额捐赠者绕开 DNC
dem.detail_en: DNC cash ~$16.5M, debt $18.3M; party war chest ~$400M, far below GOP ~$1B; House campaign cash R $89M vs D $76M (Federal filings Oct); big donors bypass DNC

dem.detail: 约 60% 民主党认为美国“过于挺以”（2024 仅 45%）；AIPAC 与进步派在初选正面对撞（密歇根 El-Sayed vs Stevens）。
dem.detail_en: ~60% of Democrats think the US is 'too pro-Israel' (vs 45% in 2024); AIPAC vs progressives collide head-on in primaries (MI El-Sayed vs Stevens).

dem.detail: 缅因进步派候选人 Platner 因争议退选，挑战 Collins 的布局陷入被动，暴露党内候选人质控漏洞。
dem.detail_en: ME progressive candidate Platner withdrew over controversy; the challenge to Collins faltered, exposing a party vetting gap.

rep.detail: 众院 218–214（含 1 名加入共和党党团的独立议员、2 空缺）；党内屡现跑票；任何缺席都可能失票。选前民调显示多数竞争性选区倾向民主党，议长约翰逊多数岌岌可危
rep.detail_en: House 218–214 (with vacancies); Freedom Caucus (Massie/Mace/Gonzales etc.) repeatedly defies leadership; any absence can cost a vote.

rep.detail: MTG 因与特朗普在 Epstein 文件上决裂而辞职；Massie 把司法部长拖去 Epstein 听证；MAGA 内部对“掩盖”不满。
rep.detail_en: MTG resigned after breaking with Trump over Epstein files; Massie dragged the AG to Epstein hearings; MAGA unhappy with the 'cover-up'.

rep.detail: 已扳倒 Massie、Cassidy 及 5 名印第安纳州参议员，并挑战 Cornyn（挺 Paxton）；有共和党人警告削弱大选候选人。
rep.detail_en: Already toppled Massie, Cassidy and 5 Indiana state senators, and challenges Cornyn (backs Paxton); some Republicans warn it weakens the general-election candidate pool.

rep.detail: 部分核心支持者对海外军事干预、过度挺以、与科技/金融精英过从甚密深感不满，阵营走向派系化。
rep.detail_en: Some core supporters deeply unhappy with overseas military intervention, over-the-top pro-Israel stance, and coziness with tech/finance elites; the camp is factionalizing.

rep.detail: 近 30 名共和党众议员考虑不谋求连任，空缺席位成民主党突破口。
rep.detail_en: Nearly 30 Republican House members considering not seeking re-election; open seats become Dem openings.

rep.detail: 特朗普强推 TX 重划(估 +5 席)，印第安纳等地反弹；民主党以 CA 等州反制，加剧选举诉讼风险。
rep.detail_en: Trump pushes TX redraw (est +5 seats); Indiana etc. pushback; Dems counter with CA and others, raising election-litigation risk.

opportunities: 全国普选领先 D+8~9pt（RCP 11/1 约 51–43；CNN 10/27 52–43；Silver 11/1 D+8.9，历史级），模型众院胜率 82–95%
特朗普支持率仍处历史低位 ~32–38%（CNN 10/21 32%；NYT 均值 10/30 37%；Marist 10/27 38%），受伊朗战争与生活成本拖累；情绪面利好'惩罚性投票'
提前投票热情占优：逾 4300 万人已投票或寄回邮寄选票（AP 10/30，较 2022 同期多近 1000 万）
历史规律：执政党中期选举平均失 28 众院 + 4 参院席
经济体感差（通胀/生活成本），利于“惩罚性投票”翻执政党
共和党众院裸多数：14 个 R 竞争席 vs 仅 4 个 D 竞争席，暴露度高
flaws: 资金劣势（全党战备约 $400M vs 共和党 ~$1B；众院现金 R $89M vs D $76M，Federal filings 10月）
党内路线分裂，进步/建制互相消耗
“软弱”人设（民调显示多数认为民主党面对特朗普不够强硬）
参议院地形不利：35 席改选中 16 安全 R vs 9 安全 D，真竞争仅 10 席
候选人筛选与筹款效率问题（DNC 被批管理混乱、一度因钓鱼邮件损失 $29k）
opportunities_en: National popular vote lead D+8~9pt (RCP ~51-43 on 11/1; CNN 52-43 on 10/27; Silver D+8.9 on 11/1; historic); model House win 82-95%
Trump approval stuck at historic lows ~32-38% (CNN 10/21 32%; NYT avg 10/30 37%; Marist 10/27 38%), dragged by the Iran war and cost of living; favors 'punish-the-incumbent' voting
Early-vote enthusiasm edge: 43M+ ballots already cast or returned (AP 10/30, ~10M ahead of 2022)
Historical pattern: incumbent party loses avg 28 House + 4 Senate seats at midterms
Poor economic sentiment (inflation/cost of living) favors 'punish-the-incumbent' flips
GOP razor-thin House: 14 R competitive seats vs only 4 D; high exposure
flaws_en: Funding disadvantage (party war chest ~$400M vs GOP ~$1B; House cash R $89M vs D $76M, Federal filings Oct)
Intra-party ideological split, progressives vs establishment bleed each other
'Weak' image (polls show most think Dems aren't tough enough against Trump)
Tough Senate map: of 35 seats up, 16 safe R vs 9 safe D, only ~10 truly competitive
Candidate vetting and fundraising efficiency issues (DNC criticized as mismanaged; once lost $29k to a phishing email)

opportunities: 参议院地形有利：35 席改选中 16 安全 R、仅 10 真竞争（6 R 竞争席），只需丢 ≤2 即保多数
选区重划（TX 估 +5 席）可补裸多数
特朗普动员力 + MAGA 基本盘，初选高度统一
民主党资金与团结劣势可借力
flaws: 众院裸多数（218–214，丢 ≤3 即失）
特朗普支持率 ~32–38%（NYT 均值 10/30 37%）成'公投'拖累（中期选举通常惩罚执政党）；取消周末集会改电话集会，被解读为对现场气氛缺乏信心
Epstein/MAGA 内裂与初选清洗，可能削弱大选竞争力
退休潮（近 30 人）放大空缺席风险
经济体感差引发惩罚性投票
opportunities_en: Favorable Senate map: of 35 seats up, 16 safe R, only ~10 truly competitive (6 R contested); need lose ≤2 to hold
Redistricting (TX est +5) can pad the thin majority
Trump mobilization + MAGA base, high primary unity
Dems' funding and unity disadvantages are exploitable
flaws_en: Razor-thin House (218–214, lose ≤3 and it's gone)
Trump's low poll numbers become a 'referendum' drag (midterms usually punish incumbents)
Epstein / MAGA rifts and primary purges may weaken general-election competitiveness
Poor economic sentiment triggers punish-the-incumbent voting

party_dynamics.source_en: Compiled from POLITICO, AP/ifeng, Xinhua Global, Ahram, USA Today, WaPo/Cankao, Pew 10/8, Reuters/Ipsos, Silver Bulletin 10/13, Fox News 10/11-13, RCP 10/13 and other 2026 public reports.

iran.as_of: 2026-11-02（选前 48h：卡塔尔斡旋'两天计划'谈判进入第三天、油价高位回落、OPEC+ 按兵不动）
iran.source: 综合 CCTV/央视网、新华社、环球时报、Al Jazeera、Reuters/Ipsos、GlobalSecurity、WaPo/参考消息、CNA、OilPrice、RO-AR、新浪财经 10/1–10/15 报道
iran.status: 选前谈判窗口：美伊'两天计划'（第一天美方履约、第二天霍尔木兹重开）在卡塔尔斡旋下谈判；特朗普称战争'很快会以这种或那种方式结束'，鲁比奥称尚未决定新一轮打击；内塔尼亚胡 10/31 敦促特朗普选后'立即恢复战争'，特朗普现阶段要让谈判充分展开
timeline: 2/28 美以对伊朗发动打击，区域冲突爆发（至今约 7 个月）
4月 美伊一度停火；6月 签署谅解备忘录(MoU)，拟结束冲突并谈核
8月 MoU 崩溃并到期，战事重燃
9/1–9/2 美军再袭伊朗革命卫队霍尔木兹周边目标；伊朗向约旦/阿联酋/巴林/伊拉克/科威特美军基地发射导弹（伊朗方面 18 死/142 伤，CGTN/伊朗卫生部）
9/9–9/10 美军阿帕奇在霍尔木兹附近遭伊朗无人机击落；美军 9/10 报复性空袭伊朗本土
9/21 美军打击 Larak 岛火箭发射器；伊朗报复打击约旦/阿联酋美军基地
9/23 联大期间美伊间接会谈；伊朗提若解除封锁 7 天内重开霍尔木兹
9/26 特朗普拒绝伊朗 7 天停火提案；美军打击伊朗约 10 个目标（回应无人机袭油轮）
9/27 美军连续第二天打击伊朗约 10 个目标；伊朗威胁「地狱」式回击
9/28 美军对阿巴斯港附近无人机地面控制站做短暂防御性空袭、击落数架无人机；伊朗革命卫队称打击科威特/巴林美军基地；Centcom 称 9/28–29 未对伊朗本土发起岸上打击
9/28–9/30 卡塔尔斡旋下美伊继续分别与调解方接触，冲突呈「有限互袭 + 谈判」拉锯，未全面升级
民调：特朗普支持率 32%（Reuters/Ipsos 9/21，生涯最低；RCP 等均值 9/28 约 38%）· 仅 34% 美国人赞成对伊空袭
10/8 伊朗上周在霍尔木兹袭击 ≥9 艘船只（战来最高；WaPo/参考消息）；油价跳涨 ~5% 至布伦特 $105
10/8 美国对伊朗新增制裁（17 艘船只）；法国/沙特研究保护 Yanbu 油港
10/9 特朗普承诺 11/3 选前不打击伊朗，称谈判有进展；油价回落；但 IRGC 警告追击 Strait 外船只、LNG 油轮起火
10/9 飓风 Isaias 关停墨西哥湾 ~62–71% 产量（约 130 万桶/日）
10/11 布伦特回升至 $105（谈判破裂）；伊朗：不会坐等美国选举出结果，无论选前选后都将回应
10/14 布伦特结算 $106.06–106.51（OilPrice/RO-AR）；WTI $95.09（三周高）；霍尔木兹单日再袭 6 艘、过去一周 13+ 艘（战来最密集），油轮+集装箱船遭不明弹体击中
10/14 特朗普排除 11/3 选前重大打击，五角大楼奉命准备选后多日攻击计划；伊朗改霍尔木兹战术、刻意维持油价高位以影响美中期选举（Iran Intl）
10/14 胡塞袭击沙特 Aramco 达兰行政楼（有限火灾，3 层受损）；沙特能源部确认
10/14 美国 9月 CPI 同比 +3.7%（预期 3.6）超预期，推升 Fed 10月加息概率至 43.7%

10/30 一艘卡塔尔 LNG 船在霍尔木兹遇袭起火，海湾国家谴责；布伦特周五反弹逾 2%

iran.status_en: Pre-election talks window: US-Iran 'two-day plan' (US complies day 1, Hormuz reopens day 2) under Qatari mediation; Trump says the war ends 'very soon, one way or the other'; Rubio says no decision yet on fresh strikes; Netanyahu on 10/31 urged Trump to 'resume the war immediately' after 11/3, while Trump wants talks to play out
timeline_en: 2/28 US–Israel struck Iran, regional conflict erupted (~7 months ago)
April: brief US–Iran ceasefire; June: signed MoU, intended to end conflict and talk nuclear
August: MoU collapsed and expired, fighting reignited
9/1–9/2 US struck IRGC Hormuz-area targets; Iran fired missiles at US bases in Jordan/UAE/Bahrain/Iraq/Kuwait (Iran: 18 killed / 142 wounded, CGTN/Iran Health Ministry)
9/9–9/10 US Apache downed by Iranian drone near Hormuz; US retaliatory airstrikes on Iranian homeland 9/10
9/21 US struck Larak Island rocket launchers; Iran retaliated against Jordan/UAE US bases
9/23 Indirect US–Iran talks during UNGA; Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within 7 days if blockade lifted
9/26 Trump rejected Iran's 7-day ceasefire proposal; US struck ~10 Iranian targets (response to drone hitting a tanker)
9/27 US struck ~10 more targets, second consecutive day; Iran threatened 'hellish' retaliation
9/28 US brief defensive airstrike on a drone ground-control station near Abbas Port, downed several drones; IRGC said it hit US bases in Kuwait/Bahrain; CENTCOM said no ashore strikes on Iran 9/28–29
9/28–9/30 Via Qatar, US and Iran separately kept talking with mediators; conflict a 'limited strikes + talks' stalemate, no full escalation
Poll: Trump approval 32% (Reuters/Ipsos 9/21, career low; RCP avg ~38% by 9/28) · only 34% of Americans approve strikes on Iran
10/29 WSJ: top commander briefed Trump on post-election military options; Trump repeatedly threatened to resume strikes after the midterms
10/30 A Qatari LNG carrier hit and set afire in Hormuz; Gulf states condemn; Brent rebounded +2% Friday
10/31 'Direct and sharp' Trump-Netanyahu call: Israel urged resuming the war right after 11/3; Trump wants talks to play out (CCTV/Israeli sources)
11/1 IRGC: two tankers (incl. one VLCC) hit mines while transiting without authorization; UKMTO reported another ship struck; at Manama Dialogue the US said it extended a negotiating hand
11/1-11/2 Iran FM: agreed to a 'two-day plan' (US complies day 1, strait reopens to normal day 2); OPEC+ holds Dec quotas; Brent eased to ~$110-112, WTI ~$102
facts_en: Oil: Brent ~$110-112 on 11/1-2 (eased pre-election after Friday's +2%; hit six-month high in Oct); WTI ~$102; OPEC+ holds Dec quotas
Hormuz: vessels transiting with transponders off; three attacks in 10/30-11/1 (Qatari LNG carrier, two tankers mined, one ship struck)
Early voting: 43M+ ballots cast or returned (AP 10/30, ~10M ahead of 2022)
Trump approval: NYT average 37% on 10/30 (CNN 10/21 32%, Marist 10/27 38%), net approval near historic lows; Iran war and cost of living the main drags
Iran FM confirms 'two-day plan': US complies day 1, Hormuz reopens to pre-war traffic day 2; conditions per the Islamabad MoU
Israeli channel: Netanyahu urged Trump on 10/31 to 'resume the war immediately' post-election and voiced alarm at Qatar mediation; White House and PMO decline comment
iran.midterm_impact_en: War is a core midterm issue: ① Economic — Hormuz blockade pushes oil/gas prices (Brent $106), worsens inflation, hurts the incumbent; ② Public opinion — most Americans oppose the war (only 34% approve strikes), weakening Trump's base; ③ if it expands into full war or major US casualties, it would reshape the election. Models/markets' 'Dem retake both' pricing already prices this in; ④ war-driven oil pushed Sept CPI to +3.7%, lifting Fed Oct hike odds to 43.7% — tightening the war→oil→rates→vote chain.
iran.risk_en: Key red lines: major US casualties, a large tanker sunk, Gulf energy facilities heavily hit — any of these could trigger Trump's 'bigger strike', turning deterrence into reality.

fed.narrative: 10/27–28 会议按兵不动：维持 3.75%–4.00%（10:2，理事 Cook 与 Cleveland 联储 Hammack 投票主张加息 25bp），符合市场广泛预期，选前敏感时点选择观望。沃什（主席）记者会：9 月加息后部分企业与家庭金融条件收紧、但整体未达紧绷；声明称通胀仍高、就业稳固；会上无人提及中期选举；并宣布 2027–28 年起减少议息会议频次。9 月 CPI +3.7% 超预期后 CME 一度把 10 月加息概率推至 ~44%，最终 'hold' 兑现。分析师普遍预计 12/8–9 会议再加息 25bp（华泰、东方金诚等），理由是油价高位（布伦特 $110+）、核心通胀粘性与 9 月点阵图指引；2027 年仍可能延续加息。

fed.narrative_en: The Oct 27-28 meeting held the range at 3.75%-4.00% (10-2 vote; Gov. Cook and Cleveland's Hammack dissented for +25bp), as widely expected — a deliberate wait-and-see in the politically sensitive pre-election window. Chair Warsh: financial conditions tightened for some firms/households since September but are not restrictive; the statement flagged still-elevated inflation and solid jobs; no one mentioned the midterms; fewer meetings planned for 2027-28. CME had pushed Oct hike odds to ~44% after the hot Sept CPI (+3.7%), but the hold landed. Analysts broadly expect another +25bp on Dec 8-9 (Huatai, Golden Credit et al.), citing $110+ Brent, sticky core inflation and the Sept dots; hikes could extend into 2027.
fed.midterm_impact_en: Rates are the economic spine of the midterms: ① high rates squeeze mortgages and consumer credit, hurting the incumbent; ② war-driven oil ($110+ Brent) transfers geopolitical risk into domestic rate pressure; ③ the Oct 28 hold delivered 'no hike before 11/3' and sidestepped political optics; ④ a December hike would be the first rate hammer on the post-election landscape, compounding the Trump-Fed feud.
fed.watch_en: Dec 8-9 hike decision, $110+ Brent path, sticky core inflation, Trump vs the Fed, the November jobs report
